title: GGX conductor (F0 = 1) white furnace: pixels match the single-scattering albedo E_ss(mu, alpha), not 1

tol.derivation: per group of pixels (16 groups by expected value): |sum(I - E)| <= 5 sqrt(sum var_p / N); E from adaptive Simpson in the VNDF domain (agrees with an independent slope-space integral to 1e-7), linearly interpolated on a 129-point mu grid: <= 4e-5 for mu >= 0.15, and every sample of the 1-px eroded mask has mu >= 0.18 (sphere radius 53 px), against 5 sigma ~ 2e-3 per group
tol.source: Heitz 2014 G2 / Heitz 2018 VNDF; CLT with per-pixel variance from m2; Bonferroni over 48 tests
